answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of 25 confirmed judged findings, 18 map to seeded defects, 5 are real but not seeded (F-0041, F-0042, F-0044, F-0061, F-0074) and 2 are not a problem (F-0069, F-0095): precision 23/25 = 0.92, strict precision 18/25 = 0.72. Recall by meaning is 13/14 with the tool findings included (only D13, the slot length and end time shown only in a tooltip, is missed); the judged findings alone cover 10/14, and D02, D03 and D11 come only from tool findings.

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: Under 'Fix first' the reply leads with the P0 double-tap cancellation and then lists only P0/P1 items (done page, Change slot, keyboard focus and order, reflow and contrast, hold and permit). Inside that list the order is not strict (the P0/P1 keyboard item comes after two P1 items, and the third P0, online change or cancel, is moved to 'Decisions for you'), but the how text also accepts 'P0/P1 first'. 'Gaps in this review' says what needs a person: IME Enter 'still needs a person to test it', 'Real screen-reader passes (VoiceOver, TalkBack) and a resident test are still to do', and the lint checks were 'not run'.

mapping.title: No visible focus indicator on slot buttons
mapping.reason: Tab focus on the '08:00' slot changes no pixels, so the slot buttons show no focus. This is D05.

mapping.title: Focus order jumps from 08:00 back to 08:20 Few left
mapping.reason: Focus jumps around the grid because a 'Few left' slot sits out of time order. This is D10.

mapping.title: Cancelled booking page still headed 'Booked' and says 'Show this at the gate'
mapping.reason: D09 names this harm: after a second press the done page is still titled 'Booked' and says 'Show this at the gate', with only a small cancelled status line.

mapping.title: Expired-hold error gives no way forward
mapping.reason: When the hold lapses, Book says only 'This slot is no longer available.', the slot line becomes a dash and 'Change slot' is the only way on. This is D08.

mapping.title: Permit field never says it is only for vans and trailers
mapping.reason: The permit rule is unclear and its explanation sits behind the (i) disclosure. The instructions put the permit rule and the permit field under D07.

mapping.title: 'Book this slot' shows no busy state during the 1.5 s submission
mapping.reason: Book stays enabled and shows no progress while the booking is made. This is the first half of D09.

mapping.title: Slot grid at 360 px and below sized wider than the content box
mapping.reason: The script sizes the grid columns from innerWidth rather than the content box, so the grid overflows at 360 px and below. This is D04.

mapping.title: Today's started slots offered as free and refused only at booking
mapping.reason: Same-day slots that have already started are selectable, and the refusal comes only in the Book handler. This is D06.

mapping.title: Slot area blank for 900 ms with no loading indication
mapping.reason: The grid and status line are emptied and nothing says slots are coming. This is the wait in D01.

mapping.title: Next does nothing while slots are loading
mapping.reason: D01 says that pressing Next during the load does nothing at all.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' resets to today with no slot chosen
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and slot and opens on today. This is D12.

mapping.title: Permit checked only at Book, on a page without the permit field
mapping.reason: Next accepts an empty permit, and the rule is enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field. This is D07.

mapping.title: Second press of 'Book this slot' records the booking as cancelled
mapping.reason: A second press during the 1.5 s wait cancels the booking. This is D09.

mapping.title: Five-minute slot hold never disclosed and cannot be extended
mapping.reason: The hold and its end are shown on no page, and the resident finds out only at Book. This is D08.

mapping.title: Waste hint and vehicle error not programmatically tied to their controls
mapping.reason: aria-describedby sits on a generic div, and #vehicle-error is referenced by nothing, so a screen-reader user on the checkboxes or vehicle buttons is not told the hint or the error. That is a real 1.3.1/3.3.1 problem on a step every resident fills in, and it is not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Error-summary links for vehicle and waste point at non-focusable containers
mapping.reason: Following an error link does not put a screen-reader user on a control in the group they must fix, so correcting the error takes more work. It is a small but real accessibility problem and is not seeded.

mapping.title: Date field shows a digits-only keypad while the hint asks for DD/MM/YYYY
mapping.reason: Most residents book on a phone. On iOS they are told to type slashes on a keypad that has no '/' key, and nothing says that digits alone work, so they can get stuck or confused. This is not seeded.

mapping.title: Booking confirmation omits the day, slot time and vehicle
mapping.reason: The done page lacks the day, the slot and the vehicle. This is D14.

mapping.title: Permit error on Check and book gives no way to reach the permit field
mapping.reason: D07 says the confirm page has no permit field and the resident has to work out that 'Change vehicle' is the way back.

mapping.title: Permit error says a permit is needed when a wrongly formatted one was entered
mapping.reason: This concerns the confirm page's 'A van needs a permit number' error, which the instructions put under D07.

mapping.title: Permit explanation says to apply on the council site but gives no link
mapping.reason: A van driver who has no permit is told to apply but given no link to the application. The permit takes two working days to arrive, so the resident has to search elsewhere. This is separate from D07's hidden rule and is not seeded.

mapping.title: Permit rules hidden behind an unlabelled info icon
mapping.reason: D07 says the permit rule is stated only behind an icon-only info button.

mapping.title: Vehicle step does not show the chosen day and slot
mapping.reason: The resident chose the day and slot on the step just before, and both are shown again on Check and book before anything is committed. Repeating them on every step is a design preference, not a demonstrated harm.

mapping.title: Existing booking cannot be changed or cancelled online, only by phone on weekdays
mapping.reason: Residents book the evening before for weekend slots, but the phone line opens only on weekdays from 09:00 to 17:00. A resident whose plans change cannot free or move the slot, so they are stuck with it and the slot is lost to others. This is a genuine gap for these users and is not seeded.

mapping.title: Slot grid does not fill the width at 1280 px as DESIGN.md specifies
mapping.reason: This is a cosmetic departure from the design spec on desktop. The slots stay usable, and nothing shows it hurting residents, who mostly use phones.

mapping.title: axe color-contrast failure, 3.02:1 (#bd7d0f on #fbefda)
mapping.reason: This is the 'Few left' tag's amber-on-amber contrast of about 3.0:1, which is D03.

mapping.title: 'Few left' text contrast 3.02:1, below 4.5:1
mapping.reason: The contrast of the 'Few left' tag is D03.

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: The slot grid overflows at 360 px and below and the page scrolls sideways. This is D04.

mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: This is the same narrow-width slot grid overflow as D04.

mapping.title: Status message '20 slots free…' not announced
mapping.reason: The live region is created together with the text, so the slot count is never announced. This is D11.

mapping.title: No progress shown during the 1.2 s 'Car with trailer' operation
mapping.reason: This is the permit field appearing 1.2 seconds after the vehicle is chosen. The instructions put the delayed permit field under D07.

mapping.title: Layout shift above the 0.1 budget, #opening moved
mapping.reason: When the slots arrive, the content below jumps down and #opening moves. This is D02.
